description: Project K-SAR (Kaligtasan-SAR) is an advanced Earth observation decision-support framework engineered for the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge. Focusing on vulnerable tropical river basins, our initiative investigates multi-temporal Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) backscatter dynamics, polarimetric phase coherence, and ancillary socio-spatial indices to evaluate rapid flood dynamics, surface deformation, and emergency infrastructure triage.
